title: NotificationEvent
description: device -> server, plain HTTP POST (not over the device WebSocket) from the Event Channel (design doc D-20/§6.1: `services/channel/*` observes notification events and POSTs them outbound to a configured endpoint). Not part of the hello/welcome/step/result/error handshake family, so it carries no `type` discriminator distinguishing it from other messages the way those do — but it does carry `type: "notification"` as an event-kind tag, since droidthumb-android's Event Channel envelope (`ChannelEvent`) is a generic `{type, timestamp, data}` shape built to carry other event kinds later, even though only notification events exist in v0. Reconciled 2026-09-25 against droidthumb-android's actual `services/channel/*` output (ChannelEvent + ChannelEventFactory.notification) after this schema's first version was invented without seeing that code — see droidthumb-server's decisions-log for why the shape changed and droidthumb-protocol's CHANGELOG for what changed.

timestamp.description: When the app dispatched this event (not necessarily when the notification was posted — see data.timestamp for that).

packageName.description: The posting app's package name, e.g. com.whatsapp.

title.description: Usually the contact/sender name in a messaging app.

timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds the notification itself was posted.
